description: This file is a shell script for managing Wi-Fi interfaces, hostapd processes, network bridging, DHCP settings, and configuring network services on a router or similar device. It includes functions for restarting Wi-Fi access points, toggling interfaces, and setting network parameters.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the 2G Wi-Fi hostapd service and associated interfaces.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Restarts the 5G Wi-Fi hostapd module by reloading kernel modules.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd process for wlan0 interface.
